revisionkey.title: Stable analysis revision key
revisionkey.description: Create once for this draft revision and reuse unchanged for retries.

analysisjson.title: Analysis draft JSON
analysisjson.description: JSON string conforming exactly to the flow contract; maximum 3,000 characters so it and the provenance wrappers fit DemoPRE's 4,000-character memo columns.

schema.title: SRM analysis draft payload
schema.description: The serialized JSON passed to the flow as analysisjson must be at most 3,000 characters. The trigger enforces this before writes to reserve space for provenance wrappers in DemoPRE memo fields capped at 4,000 characters.
